title: Instrument golden signals + token-level latency SLIs and Grafana dashboard buildout
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce production-safe instrumentation and dashboards for Redwood runtime golden signals (requests/sec, error rate, latency, saturation) with a new token-level latency SLI for text generation endpoints. Deliver dashboards, SLO definitions, alerts, and runbook updates so on-call can quickly triage tokenized-latency regressions and load-shedding events.
acceptance_criteria: Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metrics emitted for golden signals across hosted/dedicated/private runtimes
Token-level latency SLI implemented as a histogram aggregated to p50/p90/p99 and a derived SLI for p99 token-latency <= 35ms for interactive endpoints (configurable per route)

Grafana dashboards added under 'Runtime / Token Latency' with panels: per-model token latency heatmap, per-region token p99 trend, request vs token-level latency breakdown, load-shedding marker overlay
Alert rules: token-p99 SLO burn rate > 3 for 10m, total error rate > 0.5% for 5m, sustained load-shedding rate > 1% for 15m
End-to-end test harness that simulates multi-region failover and validates metrics continuity and alert firing (integration tests in CI)
Runbook and playbook updated at /confluence/reliability/token-sli with triage steps and rollback guidance
comments: 2026-02-20 - Asha Patel: Created ticket. Initial scope focuses on token-level histogram instrumentation in the runtime, export via OTLP to Cortex, and dashboard wireframes. Refer to design doc link.

2026-02-25 - Diego Martinez: Spiked on OTLP exporter and Cortex ingestion. Found high cardinality in label set when tagging by route+model+region+request_type. Proposed reduction: drop request_id and sample by route/model only. Created PR to apply label sanitization (see PR).

2026-03-01 - Priya Rao (SRE): Reviewed draft dashboards. Requested explicit overlay for load-shedding windows and a panel showing dropped requests grouped by circuit-breaker reason. Also asked for a synthetic canary to measure token-latency from edge.

2026-03-04 - Diego Martinez: Implemented token-duration histogram buckets tuned for 1ms..500ms; added summary metrics for p50/p90/p99 to reduce query cost. Deployed to staging with feature flag. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rtd-instrumentation/pull/312 awaiting review.

2026-03-08 - QA (Liam Chen): Ran multi-region failover test. Metrics from region-b were delayed ~20s in Cortex due to remote write backpressure; dashboards showed a temporary drop in request/sec but token-latency continuity preserved. Logged follow-up: ENG-5012 for remote-write tuning.

2026-03-10 - Diego Martinez: Addressed SLO math edge cases (when token counts are low) by switching to weighted SLI aggregation over rolling 1h windows. Updated acceptance criteria and added runbook entry for when token-count < threshold.
